_doc: BiS-Empfehlungen: hand-kept best-in-slot items the stat scoring alone misses (procs, equip effects).
tools/build_bis.py checks every entry against the client tables and writes it into BisData.lua (PICK);
the planner then puts the item first in its slot for that spec and level range (setting bis.picks).
Fields: class (WARRIOR, PALADIN, HUNTER, ROGUE, PRIEST, SHAMAN, MAGE, WARLOCK, DRUID), spec (the key of
build_bis.py's SPECS, e.g. SHAMAN enh/ele/resto, WARRIOR dps/tank), from/to (level range, 1-60; the planner
columns are 1-9, 10-14, 15-19, ... 55-59, 60), slot (HEAD NECK SHOULDER BACK CHEST WRIST HANDS WAIST LEGS
FEET FINGER1 FINGER2 TRINKET1 TRINKET2 MAINHAND OFFHAND RANGED), item (item id), note (German, shown in
the planner), source (German, optional, default 'Quelle unbekannt'), name (optional, for reading only).
Rebuild: ~/.venvs/amisia/bin/python tools/build_bis.py (needs the item in ~/addons/_wago's ItemSparse/Item).

picks.name: Rage of the Storm
picks.note: BiS für Verstärkung auf Stufe 30; ihr Effekt fehlt in der Wertung. Questreihe nach der Luft-Totem-Quest: den letzten Boss in Kral der Klingenhauer looten, dann je 5 Totems von Murlocs (Düstermarschen), Zentauren (Desolace), Verlorenen (Sümpfe des Elends) und Troggs (Ödland) sammeln.
